bullets.text: **USB C Hub** with seven useful connections turns one **USB** **port** into a dependable **multiport adapter** for focused daily work
bullets.text_zh: 七合一 USB-C 扩展坞将单个接口扩展为可靠的多功能连接中心

bullets.text: Send crisp video through the **HDMI hub** with **4K HDMI**, while **PD charging** keeps a compatible **laptop** powered at your desk
bullets.text_zh: 通过 HDMI 输出清晰的 4K 视频，同时为兼容笔记本供电

bullets.text: Move photos using the **SD card reader** and **microsd** slot, then connect **card** storage to a **MacBook hub** for faster creative workflows
bullets.text_zh: 使用 SD 和 microSD 卡槽传输照片，提升创作流程效率

bullets.text: The compact **USB-C hub** is an easy-travel **dongle** for **Apple**, **Mac**, **iPad**, **Dell**, and **Chrome** devices with compatible USBC ports
bullets.text_zh: 紧凑型 USB-C 扩展坞便于携带，兼容多种带 USB-C 接口的设备

bullets.text: Add flexible display, data, and power access with a **USB hub**, **USB-C hub**, **laptop hub**, **adapter**, **HDMI**, and **charging** support
bullets.text_zh: 通过多种接口灵活扩展显示、数据传输和供电能力
